payload.summary: Single-vendor (claude_code) implementation review converged in 2 rounds. decisions.title: Treat an unborn HEAD as an uncommitted line
decisions.rationale: The Uncommitted line scenario requires exit 0 with status uncommitted for any working-tree line without a commit; in a repository with no commit git blame cannot run, so why_trace checks rev-parse --verify HEAD (a read-only subcommand already allowed by the spec) and reports the all-zero sha.

decisions.title: Regression tests land after the fix lane
decisions.rationale: The fix request scoped allowed_paths to why_trace.py, so the two regression tests were committed separately after convergence; both were confirmed to fail against the pre-fix script.
